cohort: A single patient diagnosed with partial adherence of the central previa placenta with intrauterine fetal demise.
finding: Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) and postoperative methotrexate should be considered a feasible and safe option for women with partial adhered placenta previa.
mod_finding: Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) is identified as a feasible and safe mode of birth for managing partial adhered placenta previa.
